title: Named defaults for agents and chats
text: Model and harness pickers now show the actual names with a Default badge on the matching row. You can see what a new task or chat will use and choose an alternative from the same menu.
chapters: Project settings mark the inherited harness
Start a task with a named default
A new chat shows its project model

more.title: Defaults follow settings changes
more.text: Project settings show the Default badge in the dropdown, leaving more room for the selected name. An open chat follows saved model settings, and a task choice marked Default follows the account’s current model.
chapters: A one-off start follows the account’s choice

more.title: Model defaults follow your settings
more.text: Choose the row marked Default to follow Configuration in project settings or the project’s model for a task. If the source model changes before the task starts, both pickers show the new name.
chapters: Return a project to the named default
Save the default for a task
Both pickers follow the new model

more.title: Harness changes preserve model choices
more.text: Returning a project harness to Default keeps its model and effort choices. The task picker shows the configured Claude model when you switch to Claude Code, and Submit to new agent opens with the project’s review settings.
chapters: Changing the harness keeps project choices
The task picker knows the Claude default
Review answers start from the review default
